sets.name: set1
sets.note: people, beasts and things, before the young and the old were drawn doing anything

sets.name: set2
sets.note: the same, with six poses each for a boy, a girl, an old man and an old woman

sets.name: set3
sets.note: the same bodies on a drawn country: mossy forest floor, broken ground, a stream, ramps, ledges and the trunks of great trees

sets.name: set4
sets.note: the spirits: one cast drawn white and tinted as it is stamped, so a line of descent can have a colour of its own (the young and the old are still the old art)

sets.name: set5
sets.note: the whole cast as spirits: people, their young and old, and the beasts, drawn white with a dark outline so that a line of descent can be given a colour
